outcome: Augmentation ratio (amniotomy and synthetic oxytocin use)
cohort: Pregnant women at the Obstetric Unit of the Cà Granda Niguarda Hospital in Milan, Italy
finding: Implementation of the Comprehensive Management protocol led to a substantial reduction in the overall treatment ratio, augmentation ratio, and cesarean section ratio, without any increase in neonatal or maternal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found a reduction in augmentation (amniotomy and synthetic oxytocin use) and cesarean section rates with the implementation of the Comprehensive Management protocol.
